title: Example Architecture Description
description: Canonical example covering all entity types. Validates against the published schema and serves as the QG-05 contract test fixture.

requirements.title: Stateless request handling
requirements.description: All API handlers must be stateless so any instance can serve any request without session affinity.

elements.name: API Gateway
elements.description: Entry point for all client requests. Routes to backend services.

elements.name: Order Service
elements.description: Processes and persists order lifecycle events.

options.title: JWT-based stateless auth
options.description: Issue short-lived JWTs at login; validate at gateway without a session store.

findings.subject: ELM-001
findings.summary: API Gateway has no rate limiting configured.
findings.detail: Without rate limiting, the gateway is vulnerable to burst traffic and potential DoS.

verdicts.rationale: Aligns with stateless requirement and is consistent with existing platform patterns. JWT validation at the gateway eliminates session store dependency.

audit_log.summary: Added API Gateway element as entry point.
Accepted JWT-based auth option after architecture board review.
